svg.title: Rae annual-review mechanism adapted to Billing Review Lite
svg.desc: New simplified process map, not BPMN or a Signavio export. L1 manual connection and record selection; L2 approved GET and required-header validation with recovery E1; L3 explain exact amounts, source, date and optional limits; L4 correct or refresh, blocking stale decisions in E2; L5 evidence conflict restricts Help/Later; L6 deliberate intention confirmation; L7 validated local receipt or unsaved retry E3; L8 historical reopen and confirmed reset E4. Annual plan fit, eligibility, fulfilment, Care execution and KPI outcomes are deferred. Text equivalent and original provenance are in issue-12-model-handoff.md.

g.text: From annual plan review to one-record evidence review
New simplified process map — NOT BPMN, NOT a Signavio export or proof of a tool operation
Original: Rae A1-D2 §8.2 / Figure 4a–c; later A2-D1 §4.4 / Figure 2 / Table 3. Originals remain unchanged.
Working Option 2: retained evidence-first mechanism, substantially reduced data/process scope; final route ratification is #15.
Legend: solid arrows = interaction/control; dashed blue = read-only query/response.
L = new Lite step; E = exception/return. Numbered returns avoid crossing lines. Grey panel = deferred, not executed.
required contract passes
failure
current result → L3
Back / change selection → L1
Back / correct → L3
confirm current review
failure
Retry
GET / response
L1 · Reviewer — start, connect, select one key
L2 · GET adapter — matching header + required gate
L3 · Browser — evidence before the decision
L4 · Reviewer — inspect, correct or refresh
L5 · Browser — evidence conflict, NOT plan suitability
L6 · Reviewer — choose, review, explicitly confirm
L7 · Browser — minimal receipt + valid read-back
L8 · Reviewer / browser — historical reopen
MODIFIED: manual start and bounded page, not an annual timer.
Source/profile and loaded scope visible; no Spark identity claim.
RETAINED gate principle; MODIFIED to key/date/amount/currency.
Source, provenance and selection must match before explanation.
Exact reported amount / basis / currency / processing date / source.
Optional gaps stay visible; no payment or complete-history claim.
Back corrects context; refresh clears any unconfirmed intention.
Only current matching evidence may resume the review.
Known currency/source/parent conflict → Help or Later only.
Otherwise Keep / Review options / Help / Later are intentions.
No fit verdict, recommendation, eligibility or change execution.
Same record/evidence and intention summary; correction before save.
No account change, submitted ticket or scheduled reminder.
Identity, source, amounts/date, limitations, intent and timestamps.
No key/raw responses/names/contacts; no A2 KPI claim.
Keep original provenance and limitations; no mandatory reconnect.
New reads never rewrite a confirmed historical receipt.
Local record only — not proof of Spark fulfilment or payment.
External SAP sandbox · GET only
API_BILLING_DOCUMENT_REQUEST_SRV
v1.1.0 / training requests, not Spark bills
E1 · No usable read / selection
Failure → correct key / Retry at L1.
Valid empty → no rows, not zero spending.
No financial snapshot or receipt.
E2 · Evidence refresh is pending
Clear choice / unsaved receipt cache.
Block Continue and stale confirmation.
Current result → re-review at L3.
Obsolete response → ignore, no restore.
E3 · Save not verified = Unsaved
Manual retry of current choice only.
Changed evidence returns to L3/L4;
never reuse a stale cached intention.
E4 · Deliberate reset
Cancel keeps data; verified delete → L1.
Clear local review / session key.
Uncertain result cannot claim Saved.
DEFERRED / OUTSIDE LITE
Annual usage / GB allowance / plan fit
Eligibility / fulfilment / Care execution
Automatic 30-day outcome / annual KPI
Proven savings / retained-margin gains
Adaptation claim: a narrower mechanism, not the original annual-review outcome
Retained: validated evidence and explicit choice. Modified: unit of evidence, actor scope, intention and local receipt.
Human Signavio adaptation/export and human walkthrough remain pending. The wireframe is synthetic simulation only.
